en: How programmable ammunition works
zh: 可编程弹药的工作方式

en: A weapon-function input switches the weapon between two modes: the base mode fires its normal projectile, the alternate mode fires the programmable projectile. The alternate projectile and the input binding it needs are written in the same Runtime transaction as the rate-of-fire slots.
zh: 武器功能输入会在两种模式之间切换：基础模式发射武器的常规弹体，备用模式发射可编程弹体。备用弹体及其所需的输入绑定与射速槽位在同一个 Runtime 事务中写入。

en: Base mode
zh: 基础模式
comment: The programmable-ammunition mode the weapon fires while the function is off.

en: Vanilla / default
zh: 原版 / 默认
comment: Badge: the base mode fires the weapon's own projectile.

en: Swapped projectile
zh: 已替换弹体
comment: Badge: a projectile swap in this project changes what the base mode fires.

en: Fires when programmable ammunition is OFF
zh: 可编程弹药关闭时发射

en: Uses {0} when programmable ammunition is off.
zh: 可编程弹药关闭时使用 {0}。
comment: {0}: the projectile row the base mode fires

en: This project's projectile swap replaces the weapon's own projectile ({0}); it is edited with the weapon's projectile.
zh: 本项目的弹体替换取代了武器自身的弹体（{0}）；请在武器的弹体设置中修改。

en: Alternate mode
zh: 备用模式
comment: The programmable-ammunition mode the weapon fires while the function is on.

en: Fires when programmable ammunition is ON
zh: 可编程弹药开启时发射

en: No alternate mode configured.
zh: 尚未配置备用模式。

en: Add alternate mode
zh: 添加备用模式

en: Remove alternate mode
zh: 移除备用模式

en: Uses {0} when programmable ammunition is on.
zh: 可编程弹药开启时使用 {0}。

en: Uses the weapon's native {0} projectile when programmable ammunition is on.
zh: 可编程弹药开启时使用武器的原生 {0} 弹体。
comment: {0}: the native mode's published display name (FLAK, HE…)

en: Uses the weapon's native programmable projectile when programmable ammunition is on.
zh: 可编程弹药开启时使用武器的原生可编程弹体。

en: Choose the projectile the alternate mode fires.
zh: 选择备用模式发射的弹体。

en: A native alternate mode can be replaced with another projectile and restored, but not removed.
zh: 原生备用模式可以替换为其他弹体并恢复，但不能移除。

en: Not gameplay-confirmed
zh: 未经实机确认
comment: Badge on an alternate mode whose donor pair no live test proved.

en: Written with {0}: this weapon firing it has not been confirmed in play.
zh: 写入时带有 {0}：此武器发射它的效果尚未在实机中确认。

en: Switched with the {0} input (the weapon's own binding).
zh: 通过{0}输入切换（武器自身的绑定）。

en: Switched with the {0} input, bound by this mod.
zh: 通过{0}输入切换，由此模组绑定。

en: Adding it binds the {0} input.
zh: 添加后将绑定{0}输入。

en: The {0} input, the only one it can use, holds the rate-of-fire selector: choosing a projectile asks how to resolve this.
zh: 它唯一可用的{0}输入已用于射速选择器：选择弹体时会询问如何解决。

en: Projectile donor
zh: 弹体来源
comment: Heading of the list of projectiles the alternate mode can fire.

en: Change projectile
zh: 更换弹体

zh: 隐藏弹体列表

en: Runtime publishes no projectile row for the native programmable projectile, so its label and icon are shown as they are.
zh: Runtime 没有为原生可编程弹体发布弹体行，因此其标签和图标按原样显示。

en: The {0} row carries your mode label or HUD icon edits. They are on the row, so they stay in the build unless you remove them with this change.
zh: {0} 行带有你修改的模式标签或 HUD 图标。这些修改位于该行上，除非随此次更改一起移除，否则会保留在构建中。
comment: {0}: the donor projectile row the alternate mode stops firing

zh: 同时移除标签修改

zh: 保留标签修改
